reason: All 6 riscv64 CI jobs fail identically with a solver error: no candidates found for cross-python_linux-riscv64. This is a missing conda-forge packaging dependency (cross-python-feedstock needs to build/publish a riscv64 variant), not a code/build bug in psutil itself. All other platforms (linux_64, aarch64, ppc64le, osx, win) pass.
